entries.label: End-to-end Chrome connector lifecycle harness and Python bridge syntax check
command: python3 -m py_compile extension/sandbox/bridge.py extension/sandbox/run_agent.py && node extension/sandbox/test_connector.mjs

entries.label: Workspace Clippy, wasm32 Clippy -D warnings, physician-demo-db, and boundaries at Segment C Part 2 tip
command: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -p physician-app -p duet-app -p extension-popup -p physician-demo-db --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked -p physician-demo-db -p boundaries
